reference_prolog:
:- format("Label: ~w~n", ["yes"]).
% HousingQA example: Missouri
state(missouri).

qa_item(
    missouri,
    "Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for nonpayment of rent?"
).

statute(mo_rev_stat_535_160).
statute_of_state(mo_rev_stat_535_160, missouri).
allows_cure(mo_rev_stat_535_160, date_of_judgment, rent_and_costs).
allows_cure(mo_rev_stat_535_160, date_after_trial, rent_and_costs).

must_accept_cure(Law) :-
    allows_cure(Law, _, rent_and_costs).

tenant_may_cure_in_state(State) :-
    statute_of_state(Law, State),
    must_accept_cure(Law).

question_predicate(
    "Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for nonpayment of rent?",
    tenant_may_cure_in_state
).

derived_answer(yes) :-
    qa_item(State, Question),
    question_predicate(Question, Pred),
    Goal =.. [Pred, State],
    call(Goal), !.
derived_answer(no) :-
    qa_item(State, Question),
    question_predicate(Question, Pred),
    Goal =.. [Pred, State],
    \+ call(Goal).

housing_answer(Result) :-
    derived_answer(Result).

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).

:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for nonpayment of rent?
